title: Why the Far Right’s War on Modern Architecture Matters
author: JAN-WERNER MUELLER
text:
Sean Gallup/Getty Images

Why the Far Right’s War on Modern Architecture Matters

Sep 3, 2026

Jan-Werner Mueller

The Alternative for Germany’s fixation on architecture is more revealing than it may seem. Cultural policy is not only one area where the party can actually change conditions on the ground at the state level; it is also intimately tied to far-right forces’ exclusionary political agenda.

PRINCETON—Although the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) has been surging in the polls for two years, it has been kept from power by other parties’ refusal to enter governing coalitions with it. But since this “firewall” relies on the AfD never winning outright majorities, it could be fatally undermined by this weekend’s state election in Saxony-Anhalt.
